title: About Jude Hill — Web Designer in Eugene
description: Jude Hill is a web designer and developer in Eugene, Oregon. Hand-coded sites for small businesses in Eugene, Springfield and Lane County, from $500 flat.

blocks.headline: Hi, I'm Jude Hill.
blocks.subheadline: I'm a high school student in Eugene, Oregon. I build fast, simple websites for small businesses, creatives, and anyone with an idea.
blocks.photoAlt: Jude Hill, web designer in Eugene, Oregon, sitting on a slackline in the woods

blocks.text: I build in the browser, not in a mockup. You see a working page within a few days and watch it come together. Everything is hand-coded, with no page builders or plugins to break later.
Small business sites: a few clear pages that cover what you do, what it costs, where you are, and how to reach you. New sites, or rebuilds of old slow ones.
From $500, quoted flat. Domain, hosting, backups and small edits after launch are handled, and you can update the text yourself.
I work with businesses in Eugene, Springfield and around Lane County, so I can come see your shop in person. You work with me directly, not an account manager.

blocks.title: Outside the browser
blocks.text: FPV drones, an Etsy store, and a workshop full of half-finished projects.
